name: finance.spectra/mcp
title: Spectra
description: Live Spectra fixed-rate yields, PT/YT markets, MetaVaults and portfolios across 14 networks.

tools.name: spectra_find_yields
tools.description: Rank live Spectra yield opportunities across all networks: fixed rates (buy PT, held to maturity), liquidity provision (LP) and curated MetaVaults. Use for questions like 'best fixed yield on USDC', 'stablecoin yields on Base', 'ETH fixed rate for 6 months'. Returns market and MetaVault ids, APYs in percent, TVL, maturity, app links and data-quality flags. Results with thin liquidity or anomalous data are hidden unless include_flagged is true.

asset.description: Asset or symbol fragment, e.g. "USDC", "ETH", "XRP", "EUR", or "stablecoin". Omit for all assets.

chain.description: Network slug or chain id. One of: mainnet, arbitrum, optimism, base, sonic, hemi, avalanche, bsc, katana, flare, hyperevm, monad, sei, stellar.

product.description: fixed = Principal Token fixed rate, lp = liquidity provision, vault = MetaVault, all = everything.

include_flagged.description: Include thin-liquidity, outlier, expired and exit-only results.

tools.name: spectra_get_market
tools.description: Full detail for one Spectra market (a Principal Token with its pool): fixed, implied, variable and LP APYs with breakdown, maturity, TVL and liquidity, YT leverage, PT price, token addresses, data-quality flags, trading volume windows, and app links for fixed rate, liquidity and yield trading.

market.description: Market id from spectra_find_yields (e.g. "base:0xa07f…"), a PT or pool address (prefix the chain when you know it), or a symbol fragment such as "sjEUR".

tools.name: spectra_get_market_history
tools.description: Historical series for one EVM market: implied APY (percent) or daily AMM volume (USD), downsampled to at most 60 points, with min/max/average/change summary.

market.description: Market id from spectra_find_yields (e.g. "base:0xa07f…"), a PT or pool address (prefix the chain when you know it), or a symbol fragment such as "sjEUR".

tools.name: spectra_get_metavault
tools.description: Detail for one curated MetaVault: curator, strategy description, underlying asset, TVL, live and 30-day APY, share price, fees, depositors, current allocations across protocols and networks, and the app link. Omit the vault to list all MetaVaults.

vault.description: MetaVault id (e.g. "base:0x5e93…"), address, or a name/curator/asset fragment such as "USDC" or "Gami".

tools.name: spectra_get_portfolio
tools.description: Spectra positions of a wallet: PT, YT (with claimable yield) and LP balances with USD values, maturity status and suggested actions (e.g. redeem matured PT), plus MetaVault positions. Read-only; accepts an EVM address (0x…) or a Stellar account (G…).

address.description: Wallet address (0x… EVM, or G… Stellar).

chain.description: Limit to one network. Omit for all EVM networks.

tools.name: spectra_protocol_info
tools.description: Explains Spectra concepts with links to the docs: overview, fixed rates (PT), yield tokens (YT), liquidity, MetaVaults, risks, supported networks and developer resources (API, calldata endpoints).
